choice: historical empirical_background_v1; no fit or tuning; chosen from prior recorded comparisons before final data access
zero_segment_policy: Compute legacy background correction on segment-present pairs only, then append all-zero feature records for missing unordered VCF pairs. If none have segments, all records are zero. No topology overrides.
tie_policy: Historical observed_predictions argmax in fixed LABELS insertion order

preparation.phase_policy: Original prepare_hapibd_vcf phase guard retained; only missing alleles filled by observed per-site major allele, reference allele on exact tie. No phase inference.

scientific_limitations: Full VCF-to-detector-to-family pipeline has not passed independent scientific validation.
Historical component accuracy approximately37.5%; not an estimate of final-data accuracy.
Historical correction retains documented top20 histogram truncation defect to preserve model feature semantics.
Zero-segment classification is forced to official supported labels, without an unrelated label; probabilities are uncalibrated.
Existing historical model outperformed both previous fixed refits on recorded comparisons; neither candidate was promoted.
Missing alleles are deterministically replaced with observed per-site major allele; this may bias IBD and is an unvalidated best-effort preprocessing adaptation.
submission_authority: Other user chat central uploader only; this pipeline generates and validates a candidate and never submits.

method_choice_before_final_input: Historical empirical v1 model, feature correction, detector and classification settings remain fixed before final input; only missingness handling adapts to observed input contract.

missingness_summary.scope: Input genotype contract measurement only; no phenotype/truth/relationship inference.
